facts.fact: AGUIDUTEN congratulated the Banque Centrale de la Republique de Guinee and Guineenne de Monetique on the design and implementation of NimbaPay, the national instant payment platform whose launch it welcomed.

GIN.note: Consumer group lists recommendations; no rule, body or enforcement stated.
Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: AGUIDUTEN welcomed the launch of NimbaPay, the national instant payment platform, which it says promotes interoperability between banks, e-money institutions and microfinance institutions.
AGUIDUTEN described NimbaPay as the national instant payment platform connecting banks, e-money institutions and microfinance institutions, launched with the central bank and Guineenne de Monetique.

GIN.note: Nothing on tax or fee payment.
